versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version remains the same.
- No updates were made to documentation or functionality.
- All features and usage remain unchanged.

Initial release of cn-cron-parser.

- Parses Cron expressions and generates human-readable time descriptions.
- Calculates the next execution time for a given Cron expression.
- Provides a set of commonly used Cron templates.
- Command-line interface with helpful parameters for parsing, next execution time, and template display.
- Requires Python 3.x and croniter.
